name: 1social-pinterest
description: A Pinterest pin workflow for the 1Social connector: write a searchable title and description, check the image against Pinterest's rules and the board, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Post pins to Pinterest without leaving the chat. Attach an image or up to five for a carousel, say what the pin is about, and get a searchable title and description, a link and alt text. Before anything goes out the pin is checked against Pinterest's rules — it needs an image, it goes on one of your boards, and video is not supported yet — so a refused upload shows up here, not after publishing. Publish now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

Not only Pinterest: the same 1Social account also posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Bluesky.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the pin actually landed. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a Pinterest account connected to your 1Social account.
capabilities: Also posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Bluesky
